condition.name: Chronic pain (documented cause; proposed treatment-context identity)
reviewNotes: Pending proposal only. No diagnosis-specific diagnostic code, universal body-system assignment, compensability or rating framework is asserted. Owner review must decide whether this broad treatment-context identity belongs in a diagnosis catalog at all.

Not a synonym for unexplained-chronic-pain, fibromyalgia or any underlying pain diagnosis. The proposed identity cannot be used to infer a diagnosis from pain symptoms or to duplicate compensation for the underlying disability.

Identity admission and unchanged draft restoration would not publish the NSAID-mediated hypertension aggravation edge, approve its individual probability framing or verify PMID 32322101. Clinical/legal and citation review remain separate.

scope.definition: Proposed primary context for documented chronic pain of an established cause treated with chronic NSAIDs. It is not unexplained chronic pain, a new inferred disease or a generic direct pain-to-hypertension claim. Owner must elect the identity definition, appropriate placement and rating boundary before approval.
scope.ratingRationale: No defensible single rating authority was supplied for this broad construct. Rating references are intentionally empty rather than borrowing the unexplained-chronic-pain framework or inventing a code; owner rating-scope review is an unresolved blocker.

distinctFrom.rationale: The archived draft describes NSAID treatment for pain of any documented cause, not an exclusion-based unexplained-pain diagnosis. The owner declined re-rooting on 2026-10-08.
The draft does not establish fibromyalgia or its diagnosis-specific rating identity. Shared chronic pain symptoms or treatment do not make the conditions interchangeable.
